# lean-constellation target: `rootedNonroot_inverse_quadratic_of_child_admissible`

In namespace `PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice`, the theorem is named exactly
`PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.rootedNonroot_inverse_quadratic_of_child_admissible`.

Let `V` be a finite type with decidable equality, let `G` be a simple graph on `V` with decidable
adjacency, let `hG : G.IsTree`, let `w : V → ℤ`, and let `ρ : V`. For every attached child

`c : {c : V // c ∈ rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ}`,

use the established canonical `Fintype.ofFinite` and deleted-edge `DecidableRel` instances, and
assume exactly

`IsAdmissibleRootedTree (rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1).toSimpleGraph (fun x => w (x : V))
(rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1)`.

No ambient hypothesis `IsAdmissibleRootedTree G w ρ` is assumed. Put

`R := {v : V // v ≠ ρ}`

and define the rational nonroot principal block verbatim by

`D := (rootedGram G w).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val`.

Then the exact existing rational inverse quadratic form equals the unchanged child-capacity sum:

`∑ x : R, ∑ y : R, rootedGram G w ρ (x : V) * D⁻¹ x y * rootedGram G w (y : V) ρ =
rootedChildCapacitySum G hG w ρ`.

Thus the public result preserves the nonroot subtype, principal block, double-sum indices and
coercions, rational total inverse, conclusion direction, and current `rootedChildCapacitySum`
representation, replacing only ambient admissibility by pointwise admissibility of the attached
child components.

theorem PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.rootedNonroot_inverse_quadratic_of_child_admissible
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.IsTree) (w : V → ℤ)
    (ρ : V) :
    let R := {v : V // v ≠ ρ}
    let I := {c : V // c ∈ rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ}
    letI : Fintype R := Fintype.ofFinite R
    letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
    letI : ∀ c : I, Fintype (rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1) :=
      fun c => Fintype.ofFinite _
    letI : ∀ c : I, DecidableRel (rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1).toSimpleGraph.Adj := fun c => by
      intro x y
      change Decidable ((G.deleteEdges {s(ρ, c.1)}).Adj (x : V) (y : V))
      infer_instance
    let D : Matrix R R ℚ := (rootedGram G w).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val
    (∀ c : I, IsAdmissibleRootedTree (rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1).toSimpleGraph
      (fun x => w (x : V)) (rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1)) →
      ∑ x : R, ∑ y : R,
        rootedGram G w ρ (x : V) * D⁻¹ x y * rootedGram G w (y : V) ρ =
          rootedChildCapacitySum G hG w ρ := by
  sorry
